## Copy this row

A row that changes nothing: `value` and `expect` both hold the base value. Change `value` to the number you want.

```json
{
  "op": "set",
  "catalog": "finance-rules",
  "key": "classic",
  "path": "bankruptcy.buildingRefund.den",

  "expect": {"bankruptcy.buildingRefund.den":2}
}
```
